# Reference components

These MIT-licensed fixtures let preservation checks run without sibling
repositories or downloads. They are development files and are excluded from
the Sine installation archive.

- `media-player/`: Zia Media Player 1.0.8, commit
  `8364994b7f6daeb983f0cc42881ff648717141c6`, from
  https://github.com/natsufatsu/zia-media-player.
- `split-tabs/`: Zia Split Tabs 1.0.7, commit
  `5738b6e44a76c29582024f2986c6547ace5d6879`, from
  https://github.com/natsufatsu/zia-split-tabs.

`fork.json` records their provenance and content hashes. Update the fixtures
only when deliberately upgrading the corresponding retained component.
